content.short: Portals.fi provides a yield and protocol aggregator API for DeFi assets, including transaction bundling and real-time data.
content.description: Portals.fi is a yield and protocol aggregator API for DeFi assets. It provides transaction bundling, any-to-any swaps, and real-time data, helping traders access diverse yield opportunities while navigating complex on-chain interactions. By addressing composability challenges, it makes swapping assets across blockchains as simple as signing an order, regardless of the underlying asset or chain. Users do not need to initiate or monitor multi-step transactions, worry about gas, or contend with MEV. Designed for developers and traders across Arbitrum, Avalanche, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, and beyond, Portals.fi scales with your DeFi workflows.
